children: Germany asset manager's Q3 revenue rose 1% q-o-q, slightly missing analyst expectations
Net income for Q3 fell 3% q-o-q due to prior quarter tax benefit
Company achieved record Q3 net inflows and assets under management
DWS reaffirms expectations outlined in its 2025 Annual Report, assuming a supportive market environment
RECORD NET INFLOWS - Co said record net inflows in Passive including Xtrackers, Cash products, and supported by Active SQI, Alternatives, and Advisory Services drove growth in Q3
HIGHER MANAGEMENT FEES - Co attributed revenue growth to higher management fees, mainly driven by increased average assets under management
COST REDUCTION - Co said costs fell 2% q-o-q due to decreased general and administrative expenses and lower compensation and benefits costs
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
